Theorem
[Hölder estimate for the Gauss map]1. ch16:16.18\group chapter-16↗ gilbarg-trudinger.lem.16.17.local-connectivity↗ gilbarg-trudinger.thm.16.15.quasiconformal-holder Suppose $G$ is $(K,K')$-quasiconformal. Then

egin{equation} ag {16.101} \sup _{X\in \mathscr {G}_{ ho }(Y)}| u (X)- u (Y)| \le C( ho /R)^\alpha ,\qquad ho \in (0,R), \end{equation}

where $C,\alpha >0$ depend only on $K,K'R^2$.
Proof

\sketch Theorem 16.15 gives (16.92) on the component containing $Y$. Lemma 16.17 identifies that component with the full intersection for small radii; for larger radii the bound follows from $| u |=1$ after enlarging the constant.

□
